# Sample Personal Auto Wording (fictional)

> Written for testing only. Not a real policy, wording or company document, and contains no customer data.

## Section 1. Liability

### PA-1.1 Bodily injury liability
We cover amounts the insured becomes legally liable to pay because of bodily injury to another person caused by
an accident involving a covered auto, up to the limit shown in the schedule.

### PA-1.2 Property damage liability
We cover damage to another person's property caused by a covered auto, up to the limit shown in the schedule.

### PA-1.3 Uninsured motorist
We cover bodily injury caused by an uninsured driver, up to the limit shown in the schedule.

## Section 2. Physical damage

### PA-2.1 Collision
We cover direct and accidental damage to a covered auto caused by collision, less the deductible shown in the schedule.

### PA-2.2 Comprehensive
We cover theft, fire, vandalism and glass damage, less the deductible shown in the schedule.

## Section 3. Conditions

### PA-3.1 Notification
The insured must report an accident within 30 days and must co-operate with the investigation.
